'''Gusepp''' was an ancient [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] tyrant known for being defeated by [[Iunist]], an ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], getting [[Cho mok/Legends|his arm severed]]. Gusepp's arm was preserved and was prized in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] era.<ref name="Topside Infiltration" />
